hypothesis: Unprofiled pool tail is 286.22ms/128 calls (2.24ms), ~30% of pool latency. Start historically expensive environments first to reduce final stragglers.
method: Per-task monotonic wall timing with 7/8 EMA, sorted descending before region publication; retain existing striped queues/work stealing. Mode1 times only; mode2 sorts. No engine changes or environment memory movement. Schedules are nondeterministic; observation equivalence must hold.
caveats: Elapsed task time includes preemption; history is a noisy cost predictor.
